note: Each bounded probe's verdict, its identities, and what it became.

dff_clump_ids.answer: The rule is the wrong rule for these members: a DFF stream is more than one top-level section. A walk over the whole member consumes it exactly, and the sequence is Clump(0x10) then Extension(0x03).
dff_clump_ids.became: a page note (Stadiums) plus counts on presentation.camera_paths
not_claimed: a clump's geometry, materials or frames; that is a different reader from the texture-dictionary one this module ships
dff_clump_ids.question: The owner's disc map left all 2,708 .dff members as a raw magic because a single-section length rule -- section bytes + 12 == the file -- fails on every one of them.
dff_clump_ids.verdict: answered: the ids ARE RenderWare and Midway wrote no variant

htpc_cpth.became: a reader with a row: presentation.camera_paths, read-only-mapped
htpc_cpth.correction: The owner's scoping study names this family HTPC, which is its tag read as a little-endian word. The bytes on the disc are CPTH.
not_claimed: what a 32-byte record's fields are; they read as IEEE floats and nothing here says which is a position and which a time
htpc_cpth.shape: char[4] 'CPTH', u32 (unnamed), u32 records, u32 0, then records x 32 bytes

cross_check_against_the_ini_files.note: The disc carries one <two letters>_crowd.ini and one <two letters>_glogo.rtd per NFL team. The 2003 disc adds the prefix ht to both lists -- the Houston Texans, the team the NFL added for the 2002 season -- and the roster's block count moves with them.

not_claimed: what any of the 36 numeric bytes mean, beyond byte +68 (the block ordinal) and byte +72 (exactly 18 distinct values, 0..17)
roster_rst.shape: u32 18 then 18 x 100-byte records per block; two 32-byte NUL-terminated ASCII name fields and 36 numeric bytes per record

wiff.became: counts and a refusal on the row presentation.camera_paths, read-only-mapped
wiff.shape: big-endian RIFF: char[4] 'WIFF', u32 big-endian body bytes, char[4] form type
